thesis: The episode discusses the book 'The Fabric of Civilization,' which argues that textiles are a central driver of human history, technology, and science, often becoming so ubiquitous that they disappear into everyday life. The speakers explore how the agricultural and industrial revolutions were fundamentally about fiber production, contrasting the immense labor required in pre-industrial times with the modern abundance that leads to 'textile amnesia.'
